name: Materialize Munitions' [Class Bonus] discount and material-deck Bullet materialize
notes: Seeds a RANGER champion for the Class Bonus, discounting the printed 3-reserve activation cost to 2 (confirmed by needing only 2 reps of the myHand-0 reserve-payment decision, not 3), and a real 0-memory-cost Bullet (Plated Bullet) into the material zone -- this fixture's own deck's Material section has no Bullet cards. Materializing the chosen bullet routes through the normal CUSTOM 'MATERIALIZE' handler shared with the MAT-phase flow and pays its own (0) memory cost automatically.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate.
Materialize a Bullet card from your material deck. (You still pay its costs.)
